items.label: NAD+ precursor × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: 2026 meta-analysis (n=1599) shows significant endurance and QoL gains but is null on fatigue/sleep/strength; niacin case report meager (42774067, 39173541). Mixed direction: NMN endurance SMD 1.02, QoL 0.56 positive; fatigue/sleep/strength null; animal NR aggravated erythrocyte maturation (42774067, 42669151). Phase-1 NR trial registered, no results posted (NCT07344636). No approved disease-modifying therapy; case report shows meager response to therapy (39173541). Oral small molecules; human safety established across 1599 participants; NAD+ elevation confirmed (42774067, 42489969).

items.label: Urolithin A × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Preclinical only: significant diastolic-function and remodeling improvement in animals plus human engineered heart tissue; no clinical efficacy (42616901, 42432192). Consistent positive direction: diastolic dysfunction, hypertrophy, fibrosis, respiration, mitophagic flux; one dataset significant (42616901, 42432192). No registered CHF trial; agent-level human trials exist only in other indications (NCT06556706, NCT07231848). GDMT does not modify HFpEF diastolic dysfunction studied in the two-hit model (42432192). Oral Mitopure; human PK and CSF penetration characterized (NCT07231848, NCT07517913).

items.label: NAD+ precursor (NMN) × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Preclinical only: significant in-vivo fibrosis, cardiac function, ROS improvement plus in-vitro cardioprotection; no human data (42573891, 42429864). Consistent positive: fibrosis/function/ROS significant in vivo; viability, apoptosis, ATP, mitochondria in vitro (42573891, 42429864). No registered CHF trial; both records preclinical (42573891, 42429864). GDMT exists for CHF, but structural/anti-fibrotic benefit beyond symptomatic therapy is unmet (42573891). Oral NMN; human safety established in large meta-analysis (42774067).

items.label: NR (NAD+ precursor) × peripheral artery disease
items.rationale: Registry-only phase-3 (n=250), no results posted; 6MWD/WIQ/PROMIS/MRI-perfusion endpoints planned (NCT07782671). Thin evidence base: single ref_id, total capped at 4. No effect data posted; direction unestablished (NCT07782671). Registered phase-3 RCT, n=250, eight endpoints including MRI ASL perfusion (NCT07782671). Single registry record, no posted results to establish unmet need (NCT07782671). Oral NR; human safety profile established in NAD+ precursor meta-analysis (42774067).

items.label: Urolithin A × frailty in older adults
items.rationale: Randomized, double-blind RCT (n=26) registered, no results posted (NCT06556706). Thin evidence base: single ref_id, total capped at 4. No outcomes reported; direction unestablished (NCT06556706). Ongoing randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial in older adults (NCT06556706). No disease-modifying therapy for frailty; supportive care only (NCT06556706). Oral Mitopure; bioavailability characterized in humans (NCT07231848).

items.label: Luteolin × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Single preclinical study (in vitro plus in vivo), no human data (42013553). Thin evidence base: single ref_id, total capped at 4. Positive but non-significant: reduced TMT myocardial injury, anti-ferroptosis, restored mitochondrial function (42013553). No registered luteolin trial; evidence limited to one preclinical study (42013553). GDMT exists; luteolin targets injury/ferroptosis beyond symptomatic therapy, unproven (42013553). Oral natural product; human safety and cardiac delivery unproven (42013553).

items.label: Urolithin A × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: CSF pharmacokinetic study only; no efficacy outcomes (NCT07517913). Thin evidence base: single ref_id, total capped at 4. Kinetics only; no efficacy data posted (NCT07517913). Ongoing CSF pharmacokinetic study in patients (NCT07517913). No approved disease-modifying therapy for primary mitochondrial diseases (NCT07517913). Oral formulation; CNS/CSF delivery under characterization (NCT07517913).

items.label: Urolithin A/B × skeletal muscle health
items.rationale: In-vitro RNA-seq: significant gene modulation (FDR<0.01) but no functional or human readout (42773997). Thin evidence base: single ref_id, total capped at 4. Direction unclear across OXPHOS/NOTCH1/PANX1/FGF9; no consistent benefit signal (42773997). No registered muscle trial; in-vitro evidence only (42773997). No disease-modifying therapy for muscle aging/weakness (42773997). Oral; UA bioavailability characterized in humans (NCT07231848).

outsiders: Urolithin A × primary mitochondrial diseases (3.4): CSF pharmacokinetics only, zero efficacy data; thin single-study base (NCT07517913)
Urolithin A/B × skeletal muscle health (3.2): in-vitro gene modulation only with unclear direction, no clinical trial; thin single-study base (42773997)
caveats: No standard-of-care comparator in any record (no idebenone/GDMT/supportive-care arms); all effects are placebo/vehicle-relative, so benefit vs existing therapy is unproven.

Four human trials carry no posted results (NCT07344636, NCT07782671, NCT06556706, NCT07231848); per rubric rule 3 these raise pipeline_momentum only and contribute no evidence_quality or effect_direction credit.

NAD+ precursor × primary mitochondrial diseases meta is mixed: null on fatigue, sleep, and neuromuscular strength (42774067); NAD+ level elevation (42489969) is a surrogate supporting only part of the rationale.
All five chronic heart failure studies are preclinical (42616901, 42432192, 42573891, 42429864, 42013553); animal-to-human translatability remains a major uncertainty.

Five of eight directions rest on a single ref_id (thin evidence base, cap flagged): 42013553, NCT07782671, NCT06556706, NCT07517913, 42773997; caps were non-binding since all totals already fell below 4.

Cautionary signals: NR aggravated erythrocyte maturation/anemia in animals (42669151); niacin case report is n=1 and low-confidence (39173541) - neither can be over-weighted, but both temper NAD+ precursor optimism.
